p-drakes-9028911300821.d:
A centuries-old design born of the sea and the salt air, the Guernsey (or Gansey) jumper was once the preserve of seafarers battling the Atlantic winds, and it endures today as a symbol of honest, utilitarian design.
Our take on this maritime classic has been reinterpreted with a characteristic eye for proportion and quality, knitted from pure virgin wool, a fibre prized for its natural resilience, warmth, and robust handle that softens beautifully with wear.
The distinctive patterning at the shoulders and hems is integral to the knit, rather than applied, lending subtle structure and reinforcement where it’s most needed. Once a mark of regional identity, and used to denote the wearer’s home port, it now serves as a testament to thoughtful craftsmanship and enduring style.
• 100% Virgin Wool
• Made in Italy
• Ribbed Collar, Hem and Cuffs
• Traditional Stitch Patterning

p-ironandresin-9819857296.d:
Our Enduro Denim Jeans are a classic, timeless cut that recalls an era when jeans were made to take a beating. To be honest, this may just be the last pair of jeans you ever need to buy - and now they’re better than ever.
Around here, we live in denim. And despite seeking the highest quality denim we could find, we would find ourselves with blown out crotches, worn through knees, and pockets with holes in them after only a few seasons of hard wearing use. So, we set out to create the most durable pair of jeans ever made. Then we set out to make them even tougher.
With years in the making and every possible detail thought through and through, we’ve rebuilt the Enduro Denim Jeans from the ground up. Since August 2017 (to be exact), we’ve worked tirelessly to develop a denim jean that will hold up to our abusive lifestyles and won’t fail us when the going gets tough. American made and reinforced with Dyneema® in the actual yarn for increased abrasion and tear resistance, our updated 14.5oz denim pushes that formula further - now with more Dyneema, more nylon, and a touch of stretch for good measure.
